items.text: Audit fix: `acceptance_allow` was documented in plan.md §4 and claimed persisted in round 002, but spec.json did not actually carry the patterns. Round 003 ran `swarm-manager backlog update` to persist `[\
]`. Verified via `backlog get`. Plan.md §4 note updated to reflect the actual persistence.

Orchestrator action required before queuing: `spec.json.depends_on` still contains `fix/dtv-validation-api`, but that backlog item does not exist in the `dtv-meta-optimization-readiness` initiative (verified via `initiatives context` — members are sqlite-migration, report-generation, this item, and meta-optimization-contract only). Round 001 D1 absorbed that work into this item's scope, and the sibling was never recreated. Left as-is, `batch-queue` will fail dependency resolution. The remaining dependency `fix/dtv-report-generation` is `completed`, so it is safe to drop `fix/dtv-validation-api` from `depends_on` without loss. Added to plan.md §11 as a High-likelihood pre-queue risk. This workshop does not mutate backlog depends_on autonomously; the orchestrator should run: `swarm-manager backlog update --kind fix --name dtv-cli-validate-and-report --data '{\

Initiative neighborhood check: downstream consumer `fix/dtv-meta-optimization-contract` depends on this item and is blocked until it lands. No sibling item overlaps this scope (sqlite-migration and report-generation are both complete; meta-optimization-contract only rewrites prompts). The plan does not need to cede any ground to a sibling; cross-initiative implications are limited to unblocking the downstream prompt-alignment work.

This plan is ready for execution. All five readiness dimensions remain at 3. All four contract decisions (D1–D4) are resolved and folded into the plan. The only action item before `queue` is the `depends_on` cleanup in i2. Suggested next step: orchestrator drops the stale dependency, then queues the item.

plan_updates: Minor: corrected §4 Acceptance allow line to reflect that acceptance_allow was actually persisted to spec.json in round 003 (not round 002 as previously claimed). Added a High-likelihood pre-queue risk row to §11 flagging the stale `fix/dtv-validation-api` entry in `depends_on` — D1 absorbed that scope here and the sibling item does not exist, so the orchestrator must remove it before batch-queue. No scope, approach, or test-plan changes.
